candidates.stability: poor — pure free is often <2% on healthy macOS due to file cache
candidates.false_block_risk: very high on Apple Silicon with active apps or large inactive file cache
candidates.false_allow_risk: low when threshold is high; still ignores swap and compressor
candidates.on_current_host: would FAIL (pure free ~0.7–0.8%) despite idle Ollama and 0 swap

components.inactive: include (file-backed cache reclaimable without swap-out of anonymous)
components.purgeable: optional soft credit only — not for hard headroom
components.compressed: do not fully credit as available; may thrash under load

candidates.false_block_risk: moderate if absolute floor too high
candidates.false_allow_risk: high if only 1024 MiB floor used without model budget
candidates.on_current_host: reclaimable ~2250 MiB / ~27.5% — passes 20% ratio and 1024 MiB floor

candidates.formula: Darwin memory_pressure free% and/or pressure level
candidates.notes: memory_pressure reports System-wide free percentage counting reclaimable/compressible pages; higher than pure free. Explicit normal/warning/critical labels are not always exposed as a single enum on all macOS versions; free% is reliable.
candidates.false_block_risk: low at 20% Darwin free% on this host (observed 57–58%)
candidates.false_allow_risk: medium alone — can be high while reclaimable headroom is insufficient for model peak
candidates.suitable_primary: as hard fail-closed component when probe fails or free% critical

candidates.false_block_risk: medium if any nonzero swap forbidden (M370 hosts often had swap)
candidates.on_current_host: swap used 0; swapins/swapouts 0; compressor ~1.9 GiB occupied

candidates.stability: depends on quality of peak estimate (must label estimate not measurement)
candidates.false_allow_risk: high if estimate optimistic or weight-only
candidates.suitable_primary: as hard component for load admission
candidates.on_current_host: conservative peak ~2.68 GiB * 1.5 ≈ 4.02 GiB required; reclaimable ~2.25 GiB → FAIL (correct fail-closed before load)

candidates.rationale: No single metric is both sufficient and macOS-faithful. Combine OS pressure, reclaimable headroom vs model budget, swap, single-session, single-model.
